title: World Rapid and Blitz Chess Championship 2025: Magnus Carlsen Wins Double Crown in Doha
summary: Magnus Carlsen won both Men's World Rapid and World Blitz titles in Doha, Qatar. Aleksandra Goryachkina won Women's Rapid; Bibisara Assaubayeva won Women's Blitz.
